quotes: (c)(1) Except as provided in paragraph (c)(2) of this section and in § 825.801 containing the special hours of service requirement for airline flight crew employees, whether an employee has worked the minimum 1,250 hours of service is determined according to the principles established under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) for determining compensable hours of work. See 29 CFR part 785. The determining factor is the number of hours an employee has worked for the employer within the meaning of the FLSA. The determination is not limited by methods of recordkeeping, or by compensation agreements that do not accurately reflect all of the hours an employee has worked for or been in service to the employer. Any accurate accounting of actual hours worked under FLSA's principles may be used.
claim_judgments.rationale: The claim captures the general permission that any accurate accounting of actual hours worked under FLSA principles may be used, but both its summary and scope_text omit the express governing exceptions introducing paragraph (c)(1): 'Except as provided in paragraph (c)(2) of this section and in § 825.801 containing the special hours of service requirement for airline flight crew employees'. Because this leading exception is omitted from both the summary and explicit scope, the scope is overbroad. Modality is correctly identified as 'may', and support and boundary correctly align with paragraph (c)(1). Unpopulated structured fields such as actor and object do not introduce contradictions.

unit_judgments.rationale: Unit U0000 is only partially covered by claim C0000 because C0000 omits the governing exceptions regarding paragraph (c)(2) (USERRA-covered service) and § 825.801 (airline flight crew employees) that limit the application of FLSA principles in determining the minimum 1,250 hours of service.
quotes: (c)(1) Except as provided in paragraph (c)(2) of this section and in § 825.801 containing the special hours of service requirement for airline flight crew employees, whether an employee has worked the minimum 1,250 hours of service is determined according to the principles established under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) for determining compensable hours of work. See 29 CFR part 785. The determining factor is the number of hours an employee has worked for the employer within the meaning of the FLSA. The determination is not limited by methods of recordkeeping, or by compensation agreements that do not accurately reflect all of the hours an employee has worked for or been in service to the employer. Any accurate accounting of actual hours worked under FLSA's principles may be used.
